item.title: **ANZ**
item.description:
Transforming Identity Management for Enterprise Excellence

As a Senior Engineering Manager for Identity at ANZ Banking Group, I led transformative initiatives to enhance the organization’s IAM framework, aligning security, scalability, and customer-centricity. My role combined strategic oversight with hands-on leadership to drive measurable outcomes.

Strategic Contributions:

  • Architectural Innovation: Designed and implemented robust identity solutions seamlessly aligned with business transformation objectives, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future-readiness.
  • Expert Guidance: Acted as a trusted SME for ForgeRock and Ping Identity, steering engineering teams and product owners toward optimized integration and operational efficiency.
  • Leadership Development: Designed and implemented a leadership framework, cultivating career growth and achieving heightened team motivation and engagement.
  • Cost Optimization: Strategically streamlined operational workflows, reducing costs by 20% while enhancing delivery frameworks to meet critical timelines.
  • Product Strategy: Prioritized high-value product backlog features, driving impactful initiatives that aligned closely with organizational goals.
  • Team Building: Cultivated a high-performing, diverse engineering team, significantly boosting productivity through bespoke training and mentorship programs.
  • Vendor Alignment: Led vendor negotiations and contract analyses to secure seamless integration within engineering operations, achieving alignment with delivery milestones.
  • Performance Oversight: Supervised 18 direct technical reports, ensuring cohesion with tribe-level objectives and measurable success metrics.

Key Leadership Highlights:

item.title: **ANZ PLUS**
item.description:
Leader of Centralized CIAM Platform for Digital Identity (Onboarding and Authorization) and Fraud Prevention, Managing a Team of 50+

At ANZ PLUS, I play a key role in leading the delivery of the Digital Identity Platform, which acts as the backbone for digital banking channels. My responsibilities include managing a diverse team of engineering managers, Tech Product Owners, and professionals to deliver an ultra-modern platform, ensuring the highest standards of automation, cloud-native architecture, and security.

item.title: **Victoria University**
item.description:
Engineering Identity Excellence in Higher Education

Spearheaded the design and implementation of a student identity management platform, delivering secure access with single sign-on (SSO) across critical university applications.

Strategic Contributions:

  • Platform Innovation: Developed a scalable identity platform to support the entire student lifecycle, ensuring seamless integration and user-friendly access.
  • Smooth Migration: Executed the transition from legacy systems to modern IAM solutions with minimal disruptions, backed by comprehensive stakeholder training.
  • Budget-Conscious Delivery: Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business needs, meeting tight timelines and budget constraints.
  • Team Leadership: Directed and mentored a team of seven engineers, fostering a collaborative and delivery-focused culture.
  • Operational Excellence: Applied IAM best practices to enhance workflow efficiency and ensure long-term platform resilience.

item.title: **Seagate Technologies**
item.description:
Driving Workforce Identity Efficiency

Led the development of a self-service identity platform for employees, integrating security and operational efficiency across global teams.

Strategic Contributions:

  • Platform Leadership: Designed and deployed a self-service IAM platform, streamlining workforce provisioning and improving user experience.
  • Global Collaboration: Built trust with cross-functional teams, ensuring smooth coordination across engineering, security, and business units.
  • Team Empowerment: Managed and mentored a team of engineers, fostering growth while meeting tight delivery timelines.
  • Operational Enhancement: Balanced technical delivery with business needs, optimizing operational efficiency through targeted IAM solutions.
  • Leadership with Empathy: Maintained team productivity and morale during high-pressure projects, emphasizing well-being alongside technical excellence.

item.title: **Barclays Investment Bank**
item.description:
Pioneering IAM Advancements in Global Banking

Relocated to Singapore to lead the development of Barclays’ IAM platform, enabling seamless self-service provisioning for complex user roles and enhancing security operations across global business units.

Strategic Contributions:

  • Workflow Optimization: Designed and streamlined access provisioning workflows, reducing manual interventions and cutting turnaround times significantly.
  • SME Leadership: Acted as a subject matter expert for identity management solutions, driving workflow design and requirement analysis for scalable systems.
  • Security Innovation: Implemented multi-factor authentication and privileged access management to ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory mandates.
  • Global Team Guidance: Provided identity governance expertise across global teams, enhancing transparency and improving security best practices.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Managed key stakeholder relationships, ensuring platform delivery aligned with strategic business goals.
  • Talent Development: Mentored junior engineers and consultants, fostering a high-performance culture and technical growth.

item.title: **HCL Technologies**
item.description:
Tailoring IAM Solutions for Global Enterprises

Delivered consulting services to Fortune 500 clients, crafting customized IAM solutions that aligned with regulatory requirements and organizational goals.

Strategic Contributions:

  • Client Engagement: Led workshops with key stakeholders to design tailored IAM solutions and align strategies with business objectives.
  • Expert Advisory: Provided actionable roadmaps and guidance on best practices, ensuring the sustainability of implemented solutions.
  • Operational Efficiency: Streamlined privileged access management (PAM) workflows to reduce operational complexity.
  • Team Empowerment: Mentored client teams through solution rollouts, enabling smooth adoption and effective long-term usage.
  • Multi-Project Management: Managed simultaneous engagements, delivering high-quality results within defined timelines and budgets.

item.title: **IBM Global Process**
item.description:
Optimizing IAM for Financial and Insurance Leaders

Designed and implemented automated IAM workflows, driving compliance with regulatory standards and reducing manual processes for clients in finance and insurance sectors.

Strategic Contributions:

  • Workflow Automation: Created automated IAM processes to improve efficiency and reduce operational overhead.
  • Technical Expertise: Facilitated workshops to understand client requirements and align IAM strategies with evolving business needs.
  • Continuous Support: Provided ongoing consulting to ensure the effective utilization of IAM platforms and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Gap Analysis: Conducted strategic assessments, identifying security gaps and delivering tailored recommendations.
  • Regulatory Alignment: Designed workforce IAM solutions to maintain compliance with industry regulations, ensuring client trust and operational integrity.
